  */A-dup/*) printf '%s\n' "slot-coverage: FAIL dup-keys: a" "slot-coverage: FAIL dup-keys: b" "pct=100.0 (type-set)" "missing=" "extra="; exit 1 ;;

  */A-full/*) printf '%s\n' "pct=100.0 (type-set)" "missing=" "extra=" ;;
  */A-part/*) printf '%s\n' "pct=66.6 (type-set)" "missing=Foo,Bar" "extra=" "missing=second" ;;
  */A-partnomiss/*) printf '%s\n' "pct=99.9" "extra=" ;;
  */A-na/*) printf '%s\n' "pct=N/A (type-set)" "missing=" "extra=" ;;
